agent_explanation: Fast close encounter of heavy bodies 2 (m~5.28) and 3 (m~14.77) with coarse dt~0.0322 (near dt max). Body 2 starts with vx~6.2 toward body 3; pair distance shrinks 1.44 (step3) -> 0.93 (step5) -> 0.63 (step6) -> 0.34 (step7) while speeds grow to ~12.8 and ~3.0. Fixed leapfrog with only 6 substeps per step cannot resolve the rapidly varying softened force at this separation/velocity, so kinetic (+504) and potential (-578) both blow up and their cancellation drifts by 23.4, exceeding the energy tolerance. Momentum stays exactly conserved, pointing to time-integration truncation error, not a force asymmetry. Reducing dt alone removes the failure.
